# Scaling Examples

These examples make numeric attributes more suitable for downstream learners by changing their scale.

> Slide deck: [d034_transf_scaling.pdf](https://github.com/cefet-rj-dal/daltoolbox/blob/main/examples/pdf/d034_transf_scaling.pdf).

- [20-scaling-minmax.md](/examples/transf/scaling/20-scaling-minmax.md) - `minmax`: rescale numeric attributes to a bounded interval.
- [21-scaling-zscore.md](/examples/transf/scaling/21-scaling-zscore.md) - `zscore`: standardize numeric attributes by mean and standard deviation.
